title: Monsoon Stew
description: A hearty, warming Irish-inspired stew made with tender vegetables and aromatic spices. Perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Peel and chop the carrots, potatoes, and onions into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and cook until they're softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the mushrooms, thyme, and rosemary. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the vegan broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
